arguments: The agent commissions freelance tasks and pays contractors on completion. This cost exists because shipped work deserves a fair market rate - and because an unpriced rate card is a spreadsheet that cannot see the work.

The agent pays only contractors with a registered identity. An unidentified payee makes the payout trail illegible one level down: an auditor descending into the evidence would hit an address with no name.
A task returned for revision costs more than its rate: the handback re-runs review and delays downstream work.
Applies only when a delivered task is sent back for revision.
